_doc: Stream E (play-test P19). Curios: MINI vignettes the placer drops every ~100 m of open ground so a walk always has something to see or do. Same recipe shape as data/vignettes/*.json (props from the kit at local offsets turned by the placement yaw; objects = note | chest | use exactly as js/sim/vignettes.js reads them) minus monsters and quest links. A placement is `{ type: "curio", id: <unique per placement>, recipe: <id here>, x, z, yaw, radius, levelBase }`. `kind` groups them (forage, shrine, remains, cache, lore, fishing, nest, hazard, camp, marker); `weight` = relative frequency; `near` = what ground the placer prefers (road | water | forest | steep | field | any); `tags` = biomes / archetypes / band like a vignette.

curios.name: Bramble Berries
curios.lore: A bramble heavy with black berries. The thorns are winning the argument about who owns them.

objects.name: Ripe berries
objects.text: You pick a handful and lose a little blood. Fair trade.

curios.name: Flush of Caps
curios.lore: Brown caps pushing up through the leaf litter. Most of them are probably not poisonous.

objects.name: Brown caps
objects.text: You fill a pocket. A herbalist will give you a coin and a look.

curios.name: Wild Garlic
curios.lore: You smell it before you see it. Everyone within a mile will smell it after.

objects.name: Garlic leaves
objects.text: You pull a bunch. Cooks pay for it; friends do not.

curios.name: Honey Tree
curios.lore: A hollow oak humming like a crowd at a hanging. There is honey in there, and opinions about you taking it.

objects.name: Hollow in the trunk
objects.text: You reach in, get stung four times, and come away with a comb of honey worth it.

curios.name: Woundwort Patch
curios.lore: Purple flowers on square stems. Every grandmother in the land knows to crush them on a cut.

objects.name: Woundwort
objects.text: You crush the leaves into the worst of your scrapes. It stings, then it does not.

curios.name: Cloudberry Bog
curios.lore: Orange berries on a cold wet hummock. They taste like summer that got lost up here.

objects.name: Cloudberries
objects.text: You eat more than you meant to. The cold sits a little further off.

curios.name: Crab Rocks
curios.lore: Wet rocks crawling with small angry crabs. They are small. They are angry. You are hungry.

objects.name: Rock pool
objects.text: You catch three crabs and lose a fingertip of dignity.

curios.name: Samphire Flats
curios.lore: Green salty fingers poking out of the mud. It squeaks when you pick it, which is unsettling.

objects.name: Samphire
objects.text: A sackful. The fishwives will want it.

curios.name: Bitter Melons
curios.lore: Little striped melons on a dry vine. They are bitter, and they are wet, and out here wet wins.

objects.name: Melon vine
objects.text: You split one and drink it. It is awful. You feel much better.

curios.name: Weeping Pine
curios.lore: A pine split by frost, bleeding amber resin down its bark.

objects.name: Resin lumps
objects.text: You scrape off a fistful. Torchmakers pay for this stuff.

curios.name: Ash Lily
curios.lore: One white flower growing out of grey ash. Nothing else here is alive, and it seems smug about it.

objects.name: Ash lily
objects.text: You pick it. Alchemists pay well for anything that thrives in that.

curios.name: Wayfarer Shrine
curios.lore: A stone niche with a worn little figure inside. Its face has been kissed smooth by a thousand travellers.

objects.name: Coin slot
objects.text: You drop a coin in. Your feet feel lighter for a while.

curios.name: Warrior's Cairn
curios.lore: A heap of stones with a rusted sword hilt jammed in the top. Some soldier is buried under it, angrily.

objects.name: Sword hilt
objects.text: You grip it and feel someone else's old anger go through you.

curios.name: Spring Altar
curios.lore: Clear water bubbles up into a carved stone basin. Somebody keeps it clean. Nobody admits to it.

objects.name: Basin
objects.text: You drink. It is so cold your teeth hurt, and then nothing else does.

curios.name: Oath Oak
curios.lore: An old oak with nails driven into it, hundreds of them, each one somebody's promise.

objects.name: Nail and hammer
objects.text: You drive a nail and swear to something. You feel braver for having said it out loud.

curios.name: Stone Watcher
curios.lore: A carved head on a post, staring down the valley. The carving says it keeps the hill safe. The moss says it is tired.

objects.name: Moss on the brow
objects.text: You clear the moss from its eyes. You feel watched over. Hopefully by it.

curios.name: Drowned Saint
curios.lore: A little statue up to its waist in the shallows, hands raised. The fisherfolk leave it shells.

objects.name: Shell offering
objects.text: You leave a coin among the shells. The water feels kinder.

curios.name: Dune Idol
curios.lore: A squat clay idol half-buried in sand, grinning. It has outlived whoever made it and looks pleased about that.

objects.name: Idol's bowl
objects.text: You tip water into the bowl. The grin seems wider. You run faster for a while, just in case.

curios.name: Dead Traveller
curios.lore: A body under a cloak, a stick still in one hand. Whatever got them did not want the pack.

curios.name: Poacher's End
curios.lore: A snare line, a broken bow, and a poacher who met something bigger than a rabbit.

objects.name: Snare tally
objects.text: Rabbit, rabbit, rabbit, fox, rabbit, ? (big), ? (bigger). Moving the line tomorrow.

curios.name: Horse Bones
curios.lore: A horse skeleton still wearing its saddle. Nobody came back for either of them.

curios.name: Washed Up
curios.lore: A sailor on the tideline, face down, one boot missing. The gulls got here first.

curios.name: Old Skirmish
curios.lore: Rusted helmets in the grass, two broken banners, and nobody left to say who won.

objects.name: Rusted helmets
objects.text: You turn a few over. One still has coins in the lining.

curios.name: Frozen Climber
curios.lore: A climber sitting against a rock as if resting. The snow on their shoulders says it has been a long rest.

curios.name: Bog Body
curios.lore: Leather-brown and very old, curled up in the peat. It is holding something it did not want taken.

objects.name: Clenched hand
objects.text: You pry the fingers open. An old coin, worn smooth. You say sorry, to be safe.

curios.name: Loose Stone
curios.lore: A field wall with one stone that does not sit quite like the others.

objects.name: Behind the loose stone
objects.hint: One stone in the wall has fresh scratches round it.

curios.name: Smuggler's Drop
curios.lore: A barrel sunk in the shingle up to its rim, lid nailed down. Fish do not nail lids down.

curios.name: Hollow Stump
curios.lore: A stump with a dark hole in it, just the size of a hand. Or a small purse.

objects.name: In the stump
objects.hint: The moss on the stump has been peeled back and pressed down again.

curios.name: Buried Crock
curios.lore: A little mound with a flat stone on top, the kind a careful miser leaves.

objects.name: Crock under the stone
objects.hint: The flat stone has finger marks along one edge.

curios.name: Scout's Cairn
curios.lore: A small cairn with a scratched arrow pointing at its own base. Scouts are not subtle.

objects.name: Under the cairn
objects.hint: The arrow points down, not along.

curios.name: Wanted Post
curios.lore: A post by the track with a curling paper nailed to it.

objects.name: Wanted poster
objects.text: WANTED: a man with one ear and two names. Answers to neither. Reward from the reeve, if he still has it.

curios.name: Last Letter
curios.lore: A folded letter weighed down with a stone, the ink run in the rain.

objects.name: Rain-run letter
objects.text: Dear Mam. The work is good and the food is bad and I have not been eaten yet. Tell Cobb he owes me a goose.

curios.name: Child's Map
curios.lore: A scrap of bark with a map scratched on it, very proud of itself.

objects.name: Bark map
objects.text: HERE IS MY HOUSE. HERE IS THE BIG TREE. HERE IS WHERE THE DOG IS NOT ALOUD. X IS TREASHURE (A BUTTON).

curios.name: Angry Sign
curios.lore: A hand-painted board on a stake, letters getting bigger toward the end.

objects.name: Painted board
objects.text: THESE ARE MY TURNIPS. NOT YOURS. NOT THE BOARS'. NOT THE KING'S. MINE. TOUCH ONE AND I WILL KNOW.

curios.name: Soldier's Tally
curios.lore: Scratches on a flat rock: days, crossed off in fives. The fives stop in the middle of a week.

objects.name: Scratched rock
objects.text: Day forty. Relief is coming. Day fifty. Relief is coming. Day sixty-one. Hearing things in the

curios.name: Pilgrim's Rest
curios.lore: A bench of stone slabs under a carved prayer. Pilgrims carve their names. Some carve complaints.

objects.name: Carved prayer
objects.text: Walk on, walk on, the road is long. (Underneath, smaller:) MY FEET, THOUGH.

curios.name: Bone Warning
curios.lore: Bones tied in a cross with red thread. The message is clear even if the knots are not.

objects.name: Thread tag
objects.text: Turn back. (On the other side:) Or don't, see if I care. — the management

curios.name: Miners' Notice
curios.lore: A board nailed between two props at a sealed adit.

objects.name: Nailed board
objects.text: SEAM CLOSED. BAD AIR. WORSE NOISES. Pay collected Friday as usual.

curios.name: Lovers' Stone
curios.lore: A standing stone covered in carved initials inside carved hearts. Some hearts have been scratched out, hard.

objects.name: Freshest carving
objects.text: A + M, FOREVER. (Below it, newer:) A + T.

curios.name: Weathered Post
curios.lore: A crossroads post with old ropes and older notices. The ropes are for tethering horses. Mostly.

objects.name: Torn notice
objects.text: Curfew at dark by order of the reeve. Fines doubled for singing.

curios.name: Fishing Rock
curios.lore: A flat rock jutting over deep water, worn smooth by generations of patient backsides.

objects.name: Line in the water
objects.text: You sit a while. The water gives you a fish. It looks as surprised as you.

curios.name: Eel Trap
curios.lore: A wicker trap tied to a stake, half out of the water and wriggling.

objects.name: Wicker trap
objects.text: Two eels. You take one. Leaving the other seems polite.

curios.name: Fish Rack
curios.lore: A rack of split fish drying in the wind. The smell keeps the birds and most people away.

objects.name: Dried fish
objects.text: You eat one standing up. It tastes of salt and smoke and somebody else's hard work.

curios.name: Crow Roost
curios.lore: A dead tree black with crows. They all stop to look at you at once.

objects.name: Shiny things at the roots
objects.text: Crows collect what glints. You collect what the crows dropped.

curios.name: Heron Rookery
curios.lore: Big untidy nests in the reeds and a heron standing on one leg, judging you.

curios.name: Eagle Ledge
curios.lore: A heap of sticks on a ledge, littered with small bones and one rusty spoon.

objects.name: Glint in the sticks
objects.text: Among the bones: a ring. Whoever wore it does not need it.

curios.name: Wasp Bank
curios.lore: A bank of earth riddled with holes, buzzing. Walk past quickly. Quicker than that.

curios.name: Sinkhole
curios.lore: The ground just stops, and a dark hole goes down further than you would like. Somebody put a fence round it once.

curios.name: Sucking Mire
curios.lore: Green that looks like grass and is not. A boot sticks out of it, sole up.

objects.name: The boot
objects.text: You pull it free. There is a purse in the toe. There is not a foot, thankfully.

curios.name: Fresh Rockfall
curios.lore: Rocks still dusty from the fall, and a crushed handcart under them. The rest of the hill is thinking about it.

objects.name: Under the cart
objects.text: You drag out a strongbox lid. Coins rattle loose.

curios.name: Thin Ice
curios.lore: A frozen pool with a dark hole in the middle and footprints going out to it. Not back.

curios.name: Blight Pool
curios.lore: A grey pool that steams without heat. The grass around it is dead in a perfect circle.

curios.name: Hunter's Blind
curios.lore: A screen of cut branches with a stool behind it. Good view of the clearing. Good place to wait.

objects.name: Stool
objects.text: You sit and watch the clearing for a bit. Steady hands, after.

curios.name: Tinker's Halt
curios.lore: A fire ring by the road, a broken pot, and a pan nailed to a post as a sign. The tinker has moved on.

objects.name: Warm ashes
objects.text: Still warm. You sit and get warm with them.

curios.name: Charcoal Clamp
curios.lore: A turf mound smoking gently, and a burner's spade stuck beside it. Do not sit on it.

objects.name: Spoil heap
objects.text: You pick out lumps of good charcoal. Smiths pay in coin and grunts.

curios.name: Shepherd's Lean-to
curios.lore: Hurdles lashed into a windbreak, a fire scar, and a crook left leaning. The flock is somewhere.

objects.name: Little fire
objects.text: Live coals under the turf. You blow them up and warm your hands.

curios.name: Beachcomber's Camp
curios.lore: Driftwood stacked into a windbreak, a fire ring and a line of odd treasures laid out to dry.

curios.name: Boundary Cross
curios.lore: A short stone cross where two parishes meet. The two sides have been carved by two very different masons.

curios.name: Little Stone Ring
curios.lore: Five knee-high stones in a ring. The grass inside grows a different green.

objects.name: Centre of the ring
objects.text: You stand in the middle. Your skin prickles. You walk out feeling quicker.

curios.name: Lone Arch
curios.lore: A stone archway standing alone in open ground, going from nowhere to the same nowhere.

curios.name: Ruined Hearth
curios.lore: A chimney with no house. Somebody's whole life stood round this once.

objects.name: Bricked-up oven
objects.hint: One brick in the hearth back is a different colour.
